# Canonical payload reference

<!-- Generated by tools/L3Lint.DocsGen from schemas/canonical.schema.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

This is l3lint's own gateway-neutral payload. Lint it directly with `--format canonical`, or let an adapter build it from a gateway request (see [Adapters and field mappings](../articles/adapters.md)). `l3lint convert <file> --to canonical` prints the canonical form of any supported input.

Schema: [canonical.schema.json](../schemas/canonical.schema.json) (JSON Schema draft 2020-12, `$id` `https://brimatt16219.github.io/l3lint/schemas/canonical.schema.json`). `l3lint schema canonical` prints the same file.

A commercial card transaction with Level 2 and Level 3 data in l3lint's gateway-neutral shape. Absent and null both mean the value was not sent. Business constraints that a rule checks (positive amount, currency code, field lengths by brand, line-item counts, sequence order) are left to those rules so each problem is reported once.

Types read "string or null" when a property may also be `null`. In the tables, an object that has its own table links to it.

<a id="schema-root"></a>

## Root object

| Property | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `schemaVersion` | string | yes | always `1.0` | Canonical schema version. |
| `id` | string or null | no | at least 1 character; at most 64 characters | The merchant's own reference for the transaction. |
| `amount` | number or null | no |  | Transaction amount in major units. |
| `currency` | string or null | no |  | ISO 4217 alpha-3 currency code. |
| `transactionDate` | string or null | no | pattern `^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$` | Date of the transaction; drives rule effective dates. |
| `channel` | string or null | no | one of `cardPresent`, `cardNotPresent` | Whether the card was present. Visa asks for a billing postal code when it was not. |
| `card` | object, see [card](#schema-card) or null | no |  | What l3lint knows about the card. Gateways rarely send brand and product, so pass them with --brand and --card-product when they are missing. |
| `merchant` | object, see [merchant](#schema-merchant) or null | no |  | The merchant. |
| `customer` | object, see [customer](#schema-customer) or null | no |  | The buyer. |
| `order` | object, see [order](#schema-order) or null | no |  | Order references. |
| `tax` | object, see [tax](#schema-tax) or null | no |  | Transaction-level tax. |
| `amounts` | object, see [amounts](#schema-amounts) or null | no |  | Summary amounts, in major units. |
| `shipping` | object, see [shipping](#schema-shipping) or null | no |  | Where the goods ship from and to. |
| `billing` | object, see [billing](#schema-billing) or null | no |  | The card's billing address. |
| `amex` | object, see [amex](#schema-amex) or null | no |  | Data only American Express uses. |
| `lineItems` | array of [lineItem](#schema-lineitem) or null | no |  | The invoice lines (Level 3 data). |

No other properties are allowed.

<a id="schema-card"></a>

## card

What l3lint knows about the card. Gateways rarely send brand and product, so pass them with --brand and --card-product when they are missing.

| Property | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `brand` | string or null | no | one of `visa`, `mastercard`, `amex`, `discover`, `unknown` | Card brand. It decides which brand rule packs run. |
| `product` | string or null | no | one of `consumer`, `business`, `corporate`, `purchasing`, `fleet`, `commercialPrepaid`, `unknown` | Card product. It decides eligibility for enhanced-data rates. |
| `productCode` | string or null | no |  | Brand product code such as MBS or MEF. |
| `isFederalGovernment` | boolean or null | no |  | True for a US federal government card, which Visa excludes from Product 3 at some medical MCCs. |
| `last4` | string or null | no | pattern `^[0-9]{4}$` | Last four digits of the card number. Never a full card number. |

No other properties are allowed.

<a id="schema-merchant"></a>

## merchant

The merchant.

| Property | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mcc` | string or null | no | pattern `^[0-9]{4}$` | Merchant category code, 4 digits. Some MCCs are excluded from enhanced-data rates. |
| `name` | string or null | no |  | Merchant name. The data quality rules flag line descriptions that repeat it. |
| `country` | string or null | no | pattern `^[A-Z]{2}$` | Merchant country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. |
| `taxId` | string or null | no |  | Merchant tax ID. One processor lists it as required for Mastercard Level 2. |

No other properties are allowed.

<a id="schema-customer"></a>

## customer

The buyer.

| Property | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `reference` | string or null | no |  | Customer code, often the buyer's purchase order number. |

No other properties are allowed.

<a id="schema-order"></a>

## order

Order references.

| Property | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `purchaseOrderNumber` | string or null | no |  | The buyer's purchase order number. |
| `invoiceNumber` | string or null | no |  | The merchant's invoice number. |
| `orderDate` | string or null | no | pattern `^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$` | Date of the order. |

No other properties are allowed.

<a id="schema-tax"></a>

## tax

Transaction-level tax.

| Property | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `amount` | number or null | no | at least 0 | Total tax in major units. |
| `indicator` | string or null | no | one of `taxable`, `exempt`, `notProvided` | Whether the sale is taxable or exempt. Visa wants an explicit exempt flag, not a bare zero tax amount. |
| `rate` | number or null | no | at least 0; at most 1 | Tax rate as a fraction: 0.07 means 7%. |
| `exemptionId` | string or null | no |  | Tax registration or exemption ID. Amex asks for it when the sale is exempt. |

No other properties are allowed.

<a id="schema-amounts"></a>

## amounts

Summary amounts, in major units.

| Property | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `discount` | number or null | no | at least 0 | Header-level discount. Visa wants 0 when there is none. |
| `freight` | number or null | no | at least 0 | Freight or shipping amount. Visa wants 0 when nothing ships. |
| `duty` | number or null | no | at least 0 | Duty amount. Visa wants 0 when there is none. |
| `shippingTax` | number or null | no | at least 0 | Tax on shipping. |
| `handling` | number or null | no | at least 0 | Handling amount. Not part of the transaction total formula; the total check says so when it is above 0. |

No other properties are allowed.

| `toPostalCode` | string or null | no |  | Ship-to postal code. |
| `toCountry` | string or null | no | pattern `^[A-Z]{2}$` | Destination country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. |

<a id="schema-amex"></a>

## amex

Data only American Express uses.

| Property | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `requestorName` | string or null | no |  | Name of the person who placed the order. Amex Level 3 asks for it under structured acquirer profiles. |
| `adviceText` | array of string or null | no |  | Transaction advice text lines. Some processors send at most 4 lines of 40 characters. |

No other properties are allowed.

<a id="schema-lineitem"></a>

## lineItem

One invoice line.

| Property | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sequence` | integer or null | no | at least 1 | 1-based line number. Adapters fill it from array order. |
| `description` | string or null | no |  | Item descriptor: the real product or service name. |
| `productCode` | string or null | no |  | SKU or part number. |
| `commodityCode` | string or null | no |  | Commodity code, usually an 8-digit UNSPSC code. |
| `commodityScheme` | string or null | no | one of `unspsc`, `nigp`, `hs`, `naics`, `other`, `unknown` | The code system of commodityCode. |
| `quantity` | number or null | no |  | Quantity, greater than 0. |
| `unitOfMeasure` | string or null | no |  | Unit of measure, such as EA or BX. Mastercard and Amex accept only codes from their lists. |
| `unitCost` | number or null | no | a multiple of 0.000001 | Unit price before discount. At most 6 decimal places. |
| `discountAmount` | number or null | no | at least 0 | Discount on this line. Visa wants 0 when there is none. |
| `discountIndicator` | boolean or null | no |  | True when a discount applies to this line. |
| `taxAmount` | number or null | no | at least 0 | Tax on this line. |
| `taxRate` | number or null | no | at least 0; at most 1 | Tax rate on this line as a fraction: 0.07 means 7%. |
| `taxable` | boolean or null | no |  | Line tax indicator: true when the line is taxable. |
| `taxTypeCode` | string or null | no |  | Processor tax type code for the line. |
| `amountIncludesTax` | boolean or null | no |  | True when total includes the line tax. Absent means false. It changes the arithmetic. |
| `total` | number or null | no |  | Line total (extended amount): quantity times unit cost, less the line discount, plus the line tax when amountIncludesTax is true. |
| `debitCreditIndicator` | string or null | no | one of `debit`, `credit` | debit adds to the total, credit (a return) subtracts from it. Absent means debit. |
| `detailIndicator` | string or null | no | at most 1 character | Visa line-item detail indicator, 1 character. Often set by the processor. |

No other properties are allowed.
